snippet.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutants Unleashed | Launch Trailer | US | ESRB
snippet.description:
📣 It's ninja time! Let the shell-raising adventures begin as Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutants Unleashed arrives on PC and consoles today! 🐢🍕

Battle all-new mutants, meet familiar faces, and team up with everyone's favorite pizza-loving crime-fighters to restore peace to New York City ⚔️

@‌TMNT #TMNT #TMNTMutantsUnleashed
